obligations.expected_behavior: When operating from a fresh checkout, reconstruct the semantic result using the pinned current inputs.
forbidden_result: The semantic result cannot be reconstructed from a fresh checkout.
Unpinned or non-current inputs determine the reconstructed result.
obligations.observable_result: A fresh checkout produces a semantic result attributable to the pinned current inputs.
obligations.state_after: The semantic result has been reconstructed from pinned current inputs.
obligations.state_before: A fresh checkout has not yet reconstructed the semantic result.
obligations.subject: Fresh-checkout semantic reconstruction
obligations.trigger: A fresh checkout is used to obtain the semantic result.

obligations.expected_behavior: Invalidate all prior evidence whenever a change occurs that determines the semantic result.
forbidden_result: Prior evidence remains valid after a result-determining change.
Result-determining changes occur without invalidating affected prior evidence.
obligations.observable_result: Prior evidence is marked or treated as invalid after each result-determining change.
obligations.state_after: Evidence captured before the result-determining change is invalidated.
obligations.state_before: Prior evidence exists for the semantic result before a result-determining change.
obligations.subject: Evidence validity
obligations.trigger: A change occurs that determines the semantic result.
